features.title: Harness Bootstrap And Scheduler Spec Lock
features.goal: Initialize scheduler harness artifacts and lock the algorithm/test-source documents.
acceptance: scheduler_plan contains app_spec.txt, feature_list.json, claude-progress.txt, init.sh
Harness README and release-gate templates exist
init.sh status reports the next recommended unfinished feature

features.title: Scheduler Domain Core With TDD State Machine Rules
features.goal: Implement pure Python scheduler domain logic for task/device state transitions, dispatch, workspace retention, and alarms.
acceptance: Pure domain tests cover task state machine, device state machine, link constraints, and dispatch rules
FCFS plus capability matching plus idle-only assignment is deterministic
Workspace keep/delete and alarm side effects are explicit domain outputs
features.owner_notes: Implemented in apps/api/app/scheduler_domain.py with pytest coverage in apps/api/tests/test_scheduler_domain.py.

features.title: Scheduler Persistence Bridge And ORM Models
features.goal: Add SQLAlchemy models and service mapping between domain records and database rows.
acceptance: Task, worker, and alarm tables exist in models.py
Service layer applies domain decisions without bypassing role boundaries
SQLite-backed integration tests can persist and reload scheduler state
features.owner_notes: Implemented in apps/api/app/scheduler_service.py plus ORM rows in apps/api/app/models.py.

features.title: Scheduler FastAPI Endpoints For User A And Worker Flows
features.goal: Expose minimal endpoints for task creation, continue/abandon, resume-entry, admin dispatch/reconcile, and worker status updates.
acceptance: Authenticated users can create and continue tasks and see resume-entry state
Admins can register workers and drive dispatch/reconcile ticks
Worker endpoints only mutate device rows and enforce legal transitions
features.owner_notes: Implemented in apps/api/app/main.py with integration coverage in apps/api/tests/test_scheduler_api.py.

features.title: Release Gate Test Matrix For All 66 Cases
features.goal: Map the release-gate document into runnable pytest coverage with explicit case ids.
acceptance: All P0 and P1 cases have executable pytest coverage
P2 cases are cataloged and either executable or clearly marked as hardening tests
Harness case catalog maps every doc case id to a concrete test name
features.owner_notes: Complete 66-case mapping documented in case_catalog.yaml. All 50 P0 and 14 P1 cases covered by 30 passing tests.

features.title: Harness Runner Reporting And Resumable Progress
features.goal: Provide a repeatable harness runner and structured result templates for release-gate execution.
acceptance: init.sh smoke-test can run the scheduler test suite
A harness runner emits pass/fail summary with blocking case ids
claude-progress.txt is updated with what changed, what was verified, blockers, and next step
features.owner_notes: Enhanced run_release_gate.py with detailed reporting, P0/P1/P2 statistics, and report persistence to reports/. Updated init.sh to dynamically read next feature from feature_list.json.
